title: Do Your Own Research: Learning to Forecast by Learning to Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.01955v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Outcome-based reinforcement learning can train language models to forecast real-world events, but prior forecasting work either freezes research context before training or deploys agentic research only at test time, so the skill of gathering evidence is never shaped by the reward. We introduce an agentic forecasting environment, dataset, and harness built from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions; the agent acquires its own context at rollout time (web search, page reading, and financial time series, all restricted by layered leak filtering to information published before each question's cutoff), and we train Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (3B active parameters) on it with single-epoch GRPO under a Brier-score reward. Training changes how the agent interacts with information: calibration improves 30-40%, and search attempts fall from 3.8 to 2.25 per rollout as evidence discipline is learned. Evaluated in an identical harness against four frontier model

translated_title: 自主研究：通过学习搜索来学会预测
translated_abstract: 基于结果的强化学习可以训练语言模型预测现实世界的事件，但以往的预测研究要么在训练前就冻结研究上下文，要么只在测试阶段部署智能体式研究，因此“收集证据”这一技能从未受到奖励信号的塑造。我们基于2,100多个已结算的Polymarket问题构建了一个智能体预测环境、数据集和评估框架；智能体在推理过程中自主获取上下文信息（包括网页搜索、网页阅读和金融时间序列，所有信息均通过分层泄漏过滤限制在每个问题截止日期之前发布的内容），并在该环境中使用单轮次GRPO和Brier分数奖励对Qwen3.5-35B-A3B模型（30亿活跃参数）进行训练。训练改变了智能体与信息交互的方式：校准度提升了30-40%，且随着证据纪律的习得，每次推理中的搜索尝试次数从3.8次降至2.25次。在相同的评估框架下与四个前沿模型进行对比评估……
tldr: 该论文基于2,100多个已结算的Polymarket问题构建了智能体预测训练环境，让语言模型在强化学习过程中自主进行网络搜索以收集证据，用Brier分数奖励训练后模型校准度提升30-40%且搜索更高效，首次证明“证据收集”这一技能可以直接被奖励信号塑造。
en_tdlr: This paper builds an agentic forecasting environment from 2,100+ resolved Polymarket questions where the model learns to search for its own evidence during RL training, achieving 30-40% better calibration and fewer, more disciplined searches—demonstrating that evidence-gathering skills can be directly shaped by reward.
